notes.title: SweatShop v1.3
notes.content:
- Added secret menu to unlock all achievements (press ESC then hold SPACE and press G)
- "Insta money", "insta reset" and "insta millionaire" achievements removed.

notes.title: Finally - SweatShop v1.1
notes.content:
We got a lot of bugs fixed in this update, but if you still got some problems - please report about them on community forums here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/496680/discussions/0/359543951721842916/

List of fixes in v1.1: white screen, slider, sound, saving, reset game, buttons, autosave, manual save, 20 more spots, achievements.
